rca_of_the_issue: Original bug: 'Wallet opgeladen' button in brand-dashboard onboarding-checklist (data-testid='onb-go-wallet') opened B2C topup packages instead of B2B campagne-pakketten. Root cause: step.route function called only window.DY.navigeer('wallet'), which was absorbed by brand-portal-v1.js _renderLock guard (the same class of bug v60.1.159 fixed for the brand-dash-wallet card). Mitigation in v60.1.161: wallet step.route now first invokes PP_Wallet.openWallet() (the v60.1.159 direct-render bypass that sets DY.pagina='wallet', clears _renderLock, and re-renders the brand-portal wallet view directly), then falls back to clearing _renderLock + DY.navigeer('wallet') only if PP_Wallet is not yet loaded. Backwards-compatible and surgical: only the wallet step changed; the 3 other onboarding steps remain unchanged.
